jobs.description:
Do you have a Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences and experience with cell culture? Would you like to contribute to groundbreaking therapies that are changing patients' lives worldwide?
 

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

For our client, a biotech company that is a fast-growing & innovative organization, we are looking for a warehouse associate.
 

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

As a warehouse associate your responsibilities are; 
 

Receiving biohazard products (blood bags, viral vectors, ...) in a controlled temperature environment.
 

Accurately process inventory receipts ensuring correct matching to purchase orders, documentation of approvals, quality checks and adherence to policies.
 

Working with equipment and material stored at cryogenic
 

Fill out the Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for incoming materials including: transport unloading, temperature control, integrity control, administrative paperwork related to following correct procedures.
 

Fill in forms & logbooks related to receiving, picking and outbound activities to comply with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) policies in the pharmaceutical environment.
 

Work closely together with the Operations and Quality department to support the Production and Lab activities for our start-up site. 
 

Work in a clean environment where you will wear dedicated gowning clothes.
 

Working in two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to process inbound, picking and outbound activities.
 

Collaborate with accounting, suppliers and business stakeholders in support of on-going operational efficiency efforts.
 

At Legend Biotech in Zwijnaarde, you will have the opportunity to participate in the production of advanced CAR-T cell therapies, an innovative form of cancer treatment. You will work in a highly technological GMP-regulated environment.
 

 
• Working daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment
 
• Ensuring the cleanliness of equipment and production areas 
 

Performing various steps within the CAR-T manufacturing process, including:
 

 
• Cell isolation
 
• Cell selection, activation, and transduction
 
• Cell culture
 
• Aseptic processing
 
• Filling and finishing operations
 
• Cryopreservation 
 

Manufacturing clinical and commercial ATMPs (Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products)
 

 
• Adhering to all applicable quality and safety standards 
 

Performing in-process controls on batch samples while maintaining the highest quality standards
 

Strictly following SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), batch records, and GMP guidelines
 

 
• Recording and managing GMP documentation to ensure compliance and traceability 
 

Supporting environmental monitoring and the maintenance of GMP production areas

Who are you?
 

You are a detail-oriented team player who enjoys working in an innovative manufacturing environment.
 

You have:
 

 
• A Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biomedical Sciences, or an equivalent field
 
• Initial experience with cell culture
 
• Experience in a GMP environment and/or ATMP manufacturing is a strong asset
 
• Good command of English, both written and spoken
 
• Willingness to work in a shift-based system
 
• A hands-on mentality and strong attention to detail

Are you technically inclined and eager to work in a dynamic production environment where you can continuously develop yourself? Then this position as an assembly worker in a 2-shift system might be something for you!

Your role

As an assembly worker, you play an important role in the production process of seating solutions, such as chairs for, among others, De Lijn. You will start with an intensive training program where you will get familiar with various assembly techniques. This way, you build the knowledge and skills to grow into a true specialist.

Responsibilities

Assembling parts for car seats according to technical instructions

Covering cushions with fabric or leather

Performing visual quality checks on finished products

Identifying and reporting errors or deviations
- Vaardigheden:

You have technical insight, from your school background, previous work experiences, or from a technical hobby. 

You can handle the heat well, as you'll be working in a warm environment.

You're eager to learn and ready to get your hands dirty.

- Attesten:

/

- Opleidingsvereisten:

A technical education is a plus, but not required.

- Vakkennis:

You have some initial experience in assembly.

- Talenkennis:

You have a good knowledge of Dutch or a good knowledge of English. Either one is enough!

What does the role involve?
 

 
• As an operator, you are responsible for the accurate execution of production processes.
 
• You precisely measure materials.
 
• You perform calculations and ensure everything runs according to plan.
 
• You work in an environment where quality and precision are key. 

Profile – What do we expect from you?
 

 
• Strong numerical skills and the ability to measure accurately.
 
• Good spatial awareness.
 
• Fluency in Dutch or very good proficiency in English.
 
• Flexibility: you work in day shifts, but are willing to switch to a two-shift system during peak workload.
 
• Careful and correct working method, with strong attention to detail.

Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks

• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods

• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe

After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You are a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics

• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)

• Can work in a 2-shift system

• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments

• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

If you don't meet every requirement but have some warehouse experience and a strong work ethic, you can still apply!

 

IMPORTANT: this job is only available for people who:

• Already live in Belgium

• Have a valid Belgian address

• Have legal permission to work in Belgium

Housing, relocation and visa sponsorship are not available for this position.

jobs.occupation: Handyman / general facilities technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician with solid electrical knowledge and a passion for maintenance, repairs, and problem-solving? Do you enjoy having variety in your work and being the go-to person for all technical issues? And are you already living in Belgium?

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician or handyman to help maintain the buildings, warehouse facilities, technical installations and outdoor areas. A very varied job that combines electrical maintenance, facility maintenance, repairs, troubleshooting and general handyman tasks. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you're responsible for a wide range of maintenance and repair activities across the different sites of the company. You and the rest of the technical team use your technical skills to ensure the operations run safely and efficiently.

Your key duties:

• Perform electrical maintenance and repairs
• Carry out minor repairs to plumbing, storage racks, equipment...
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers

Your profile:

• Good knowledge of electrical systems and installations
• Basic knowledge of plumbing, mechanics, building maintenance, or general technical repairs
• Experience as a maintenance technician, handyman, facilities technician, general maintenance worker...
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English
 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

The Account Manager acts as both a trusted advisor and a commercial driver, combining relationship management with strong sales, negotiation, and business development skills.

jobs.description:
As a Customer Service Officer, you play a crucial role in a multicultural and multilingual helpdesk. You are the first point of contact for customers experiencing vehicle breakdowns. You handle incoming calls and emails and ensure that every customer receives fast and professional assistance. You also communicate with repair shops and technical partners to coordinate interventions and keep customers fully informed.

Your workday starts with a short team meeting, after which you and your colleagues are ready for incoming calls. You accurately collect information, check data for completeness, and enter everything into the system. You juggle multiple tasks: contacting emergency services, following up on contractual agreements, and updating files. You work independently but can always rely on the support of your team lead and coworkers.

Are you solution-oriented, stress-resistant, and do you love variety? Then this job is perfect for you! You'll get to use your language skills, collaborate with people from all over Europe, and learn something new every day. Apply now and make a real difference for our customers!

• You speak and write fluent French, Dutch, and English (any additional language is a plus)

• You have at least a degree in higher secondary education or equivalent by experience

• You are proficient with computers (Microsoft Office: Word, Excel, Outlook)

• You are communicative, customer-oriented, and solution-driven

• You can multitask and work accurately, even under stress

• Technical knowledge of automotive is a plus, not a must

• No experience required – motivation and willingness to learn are most important

Lead Growth. Win Business. Shape the Future.
 

Crowne Plaza Brussels Airport is a market-leading upscale business hotel at the heart of Corporate Village, just minutes from Brussels Airport. Home to 315 guestrooms, 18 newly refreshed meeting rooms and one of Belgium's premier conference venues, the hotel welcomes a diverse international mix of corporate, 

airline and MICE guests.

it's a leadership position for someone who loves prospecting, negotiating and closing deals while leveraging the power of a global hotel network.
 

What you'll do
You'll drive business growth across Corporate, MICE, Leisure and Airline segments by:

• Prospecting, negotiating and securing new local and international accounts. 

• Managing the full RFP process and maximizing opportunities from IHG's global sales network. 

• Growing our Meetings & Events business by increasing conversion and developing long-term client relationships.

• Working closely with the General Manager and operational teams to ensure every client experience matches our commercial promise

Who you are
• A proven hunter with a strong track record of winning new business. 

• At least 4 years' experience in hotel or hospitality sales, including team leadership. 

• Experience with Corporate, MICE and RFP management within an international environment is a strong advantage.

Are you looking for a varied job where you can both apply your technical knowledge and carry out practical tasks?

Then be sure to apply for this operator position!

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.
You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

You take pride in keeping your machine running smoothly and in resolving minor breakdowns or blockages quickly and efficiently.

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C) does not deter you.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.

We guarantee that you won’t be bored
 

As a process operator, you have several responsibilities: 
 
 

• You will receive an intensive training before coordinating and operating high-end devices in the clean room. 

• You organize your own workload according to defined goals. 

• You are responsible for the quality of your own processing. 

• You perform quality tests meticulously. 

• You accurately report problems to our engineers.  

• You have a keen eye for safety and operational efficiency. 

• You suggest improvements.  

Who are we looking for?
 

Well, an enthusiastic personality and a passion for technology already go a long way. You are hands-on, full of expectation and eager to prove yourself. You enjoy working in a team, are accurate, dare to take initiative and are not afraid of asking questions. You have fluent communication skills in English. You are not looking for a typical nine-to-five and you see the advantages of working in shifts every now and again — handsome bonusses and lots of quality time on your hands while others are ‘insanely busy’. An example of our shift regime:
 
 

• Week X: You will work the early shift from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+1: You work the night shift from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+2: You work the late shift from Monday to Wednesday, on Thursday and Friday you have recuperation and on Saturday and Sunday you work 12h. 

• Week X+3: From Monday to Wednesday you have recuperation and on Thursday and Friday you work in the late shift. 

• Week X: You work from Monday to Friday in the early shift.

Qualification

A320/A330/A340/A350/A380)

Our client is a major player in the logistics sector. They handle road transport, air freight, and sea freight.

The Antwerp branch is responsible for everything related to ocean freight. Around 100 employees work there and give their best every day to provide the highest possible level of service. They are seated in groups of four colleagues at work islands, spread over two floors. The atmosphere on the work floor is calm—sometimes hectic—but very pleasant. There is strong teamwork, and there is certainly room for regular laughter as well.

Every two weeks, a fruit basket is delivered to the departments. In addition, you can work with flexible hours, there are various opportunities for personal development, and subscriptions for the toll tunnel and the water bus are fully reimbursed.

In short: a very attractive employer!

Jobomschrijving

Are you detail-oriented and passionate about data, pricing, and ocean freight? 

As a Rate Management Specialist, you’ll play a key role in ensuring accurate and efficient pricing processes that power our global operations.

You’ll manage customer contracts, tariffs, and costing data across our systems, enabling seamless auto-rating and auto-costing and supporting our journey toward full digitalization.

Working closely with commercial, operational, and system teams, you will help deliver tailored pricing solutions that meet customer requirements while supporting ongoing digitalization and process improvement initiatives. This position is essential in maintaining data integrity and optimizing the performance of our global rating platforms.

	
• Strong attention to detail and analytical mindset	
• Experience in Ocean Freight pricing or operations (minimum 2 years)	
• Strong communication and collaboration skills	
• Proficiency in Microsoft 365	
• Fluent English and Dutch
